overview.title: The square that organises the city
overview.p1: Place Hassan II is where Tetouan breathes. The medina gates pull you one way; the wider Spanish-era streets pull the other. Cafés line the edges; taxis and evening strollers share the open space.
overview.p2: Use it as your first and last stop of the day. Morning is for orientation and coffee; evening is for people-watching when the heat drops.
overview.p3: From here every classic loop starts: medina, kasbah climb, museum, return for tea.
